title: Grateful Dead Live at Music Hall on 1972-10-26

ai_review.summary: High‑energy Set 2 with a smoking Broken Down and solid Truckin', captured on a mostly crisp soundboard despite an abrupt cut at the end.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates this set‑2 recording five stars, praising the setlist (especially Playing In The Band, Broken Down and Truckin') and Jerry Garcia’s vocal performance. Recording quality is generally good – a soundboard source with clear mix – though the tape ends abruptly on the Broken Down jam.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong enthusiasm for the musical performance (70% weight) and a largely clean soundboard recording with only a minor ending glitch (30% weight) lead to an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear mix overall; noted abrupt cut/needle‑pull at the end of Broken Down, but no major distortion or balance issues mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set 2 setlist described as "pretty cool" with PITB preferred over Dark Star; transitions flow well.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals rated A+ throughout the set.
